summary: Hong Kong Lands Department GeoInfo Map current configuration and anonymous public services were verified. The exact preserved WUP point returned native lot FL 454 / LOTID 1800068273, and a bounded ArcGIS query returned one safe-identity polygon. Runtime remains held pending independent serial qualification and citywide coverage review.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Traditional Chinese first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-11560-fanling.json. They identified the Lands Department GeoInfo Map, HKMS 2.0 cadastral-record service, and related official geospatial documentation.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified anonymous GET requests loaded the current viewer HTML/configuration, identified the /gih-ws2 identify route and ArcGIS dynamic layer, returned one exact-point LOT response, loaded layer metadata, and returned one GeoJSON Polygon with only LOTID requested. One viewer-configured urgent-layer endpoint returned 403 and was not used as absence evidence.
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [22.4969823927341, 114.135123361368] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
One exact-point hit and one returned polygon do not establish citywide or territory-wide parcel completeness.
The identify service uses Hong Kong 1980 Grid coordinates; the retained sample is explicit EPSG:4326 output with [longitude, latitude] GeoJSON coordinates.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained; the identify response's building/address record was not retained.
A 403, timeout, login wall, map extent miss, or unusable UI would not be evidence of citywide absence; the 403 route was not used for that inference.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
crs: HK80 identify input; EPSG:4326 retained output
geometryQuality: One valid Polygon from official ArcGIS query, retained unchanged in returned EPSG:4326 coordinates.
